The '''Neuvia system''' was a part of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region. It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], which connected it to the [[Ralltiir system/Legends|Ralltiir]], [[Delle system/Legends|Delle]], and [[Yabol Opa system/Legends|Yabol Opa systems]] and served as the dividing line between the regions known as the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was located in an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Neuvia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]] known as [[Neuvian sundae]].<ref name="Droids">[[Droids (1986) 4|''Droids'' (1986) 4]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Neuvian sundae]]|system=Neuvia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Neuvia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
